<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral integrity concerns:</strong> Rahul Gandhi has accused the BJP and the Election Commission of &quot;vote theft&quot; in Maharashtra and Bengal, while the Supreme Court has requested the government&#x27;s stance on implementing totaliser machines for EVM vote counting.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
